page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 224.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile characterized by moderate multi-core capabilities and weaker single-core execution. The single-core performance, as measured by stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% tier, which is also reflected in poor single-threaded gzip compression and weak text processing. However, the instance leverages its 56 dedicated cores to achieve average multi-core performance, with competitive results in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation, and ray tracing. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle tier, supporting up to 104.82 GB/sec for large-block read operations.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallelized workloads that can offset its lower single-core speeds through multi-threaded execution. It is well-suited for static web serving, multi-threaded database operations, and moderate-scale LLM inference prompt processing. However, it is less optimal for single-threaded tasks or applications requiring high-speed local NVMe storage.
